body_text:
A partition of a compact interval $[a,b]$ is a finite ordered
set $P=\{x_0,\ldots,x_n\}$ with $a=x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n=b$. Its
mesh is $\|P\|=\max_i(x_i-x_{i-1})$. A tagged partition
additionally chooses $t_i\in[x_{i-1},x_i]$ for each
subinterval.
